g.text: a third of the rent walks you to the far end
the asterisk is doing the work
no window, and no facade to put one in
the only way in is through Bedroom 2*
the only place a bicycle fits
A fictional composite of a familiar genre — not a real listing and not a real address. Every
dimension is drawn honestly; the joke is the lint output. W_BATH_VIA_BEDROOM: "Bathroom 'Bath'
is reachable only through a bedroom." W_PATH_TOO_NARROW: "The walk from the entrance to 'Bedroom
1' squeezes to 300 mm (400 mm below the 700 mm minimum)." Twelve warnings, nine codes, and 19.8
of the unit's 61.2 m² is corridor.
